findings.design_says: Pool postings (일용직/인력풀) terminate the pipeline by registering the candidate into the workforce pool, not by creating an employee: nextLabel/ctaLabel = rp.pool ? '인력풀 등재(— 비상근)' : '입사 확정' (dc.html 19708, 19754) and rcAdvance registers wpJoined with '재직 명부 비합산 · 대근 편성 대상' (dc.html 12752-12758). The composer even promises it: '확정 = 인력풀 등재 · 비상근' chip (dc.html 680).
findings.code_does: nextActionLabel excludes POOL_DAILY (RecruitingScreen.tsx:80) and CandidateCard's hireable requires !isPool (CandidateCard.tsx:109-114), so an OFFER-stage applicant on a POOL_DAILY posting has NO primary CTA anywhere — the pipeline dead-ends while the composer still shows the '확정 = 인력풀 등재 · 비상근' promise chip (PostingComposer.tsx:144-146).
findings.fix: Add a pool-registration terminal action for OFFER-stage applicants on POOL_DAILY postings (POST …/applicants/{id}/register-pool → workforce-pool entry with src=JP-, avail=본인 동의/즉시), wired as the card CTA and subrow next-action. Until the endpoint exists, list in the gap manifest — do not fake it client-side.

findings.design_says: Rejected-candidate banner carries TWO actions: '인력풀 등재 제안' (talent-pool → workforce-pool conversion, Greenhouse→WFM chain, rcPoolPropose dc.html 1540 + 10524-10530) and '탈락 철회 · 재검토'.
findings.code_does: CandidateCard rejected banner has only reinstate (CandidateCard.tsx:205-212); the pool-propose path does not exist in the module or the API contract (recruitingApi.ts has no workforce-pool mutation).
findings.fix: Add '인력풀 등재 제안' button on the rejected banner calling a workforce-pool proposal endpoint (avail=본인 동의 대기, src=posting code); needs a backend surface.

findings.design_says: J/K/Enter is a screen-level grammar: keydown on the recruit screen moves rcSel across rows with a persistent selection ring 'inset 2.5px 0 0 var(--signal)' + muted rowBg distinct from the open state, Enter toggles the selected posting (dc.html 15062-15072, 19686-19687); §4.7-1 list grammar.
findings.code_does: rove() only fires when a row-toggle button already has DOM focus (RecruitingScreen.tsx:468-483) — pressing J/K on the screen does nothing until the user Tabs into the list — and the signal ring is applied only to the OPEN row (recruiting.css:23 .recruiting__row--open); there is no separate selection state.
findings.fix: Add a screen-scoped keydown handler (ignoring inputs/dialogs) that maintains a selectedId with the rowBg+ring treatment independent of open, and make Enter toggle the selected row.

findings.design_says: 입사 확정 is one click: employee object auto-created with 사원 title, team=posting site, job=role, '포지션 정책 프리셋 상속 · 타임테이블 자동 연결 · 근로계약 개인 수신함(passkey) 발송' (dc.html 12760-12766); DESIGN §2 backlog 5 '입사 확정 시 직원 개체 자동 생성'.
findings.code_does: Hire opens a 7-field manual form where employee_number, phone, org_unit, and home_branch_id must be hand-typed before the CTA enables (CandidateCard.tsx:85-105, 147-155, 340-391); only position/site/base_pay are prefilled.
findings.fix: Derive org_unit from posting.worksite, default home_branch from the posting's site mapping, and have the backend issue the employee number; leave phone as the only manual field. Keep the form as a confirm sheet, not data entry.

findings.design_says: §4-27-1 input normalization: phone numbers accept digits only and auto-format while typing — 'a badly formatted value cannot exist'; the charter's named reference case is 직원 등록 휴대폰 (DESIGN.md §4-27, AGENTS 170).
findings.code_does: Hire-form phone is a free-text input with no mask (CandidateCard.tsx:357-358 — plain onChange), and employee_number likewise; only base_pay/offer amounts strip non-digits.
findings.fix: Apply the digit+auto-hyphen mask to phone (reuse the employee-registration mask helper) and a pattern mask to 사번.

findings.design_says: §4-20: business parameters are never hardcoded constants — enums derive from the engine/settings objects; §4-27-3: every enum chip row is N+1 extensible via 「+ 직접 입력」.
findings.code_does: The 법인 chip set is a hardcoded array in frontend i18n (recruiting.ts:174 companies: ['코스','BESTEC','KNL','그룹','스태핑']) baked into every tenant's bundle, and neither 법인 nor 고용 형태 chip rows offer a direct-input N+1 extension (PostingComposer.tsx:106-148).
findings.fix: Load the corporation list from the server (org-entity read, same pattern as listBranches) and add the dotted 「+ 직접 입력」 affordance to the enum chip rows.

findings.design_says: §4-1 connectivity / §4-22 (every element serves ≥2 stories): talent pool exists to feed re-engagement — reconsider and 인력풀 전환 제안 both operate on the pooled candidate (dc.html 10524-10530, 12525); nouns must click or drag.
findings.code_does: The 인재풀 section renders inert rows — name, APL- code chip, reason, timestamp with no click, no drag, no action (RecruitingScreen.tsx:712-733); RecruitTalentPoolItem carries no applicant id (recruitingApi.ts:124-130), so no drill is even possible.
findings.fix: Add applicant_id (and posting_id) to the talent-pool payload; row click opens the candidate card (which then carries reinstate/pool-propose); make the APL- chip a drag source.

findings.design_says: Subrow ⋯ menu '탈락 처리' opens the candidate card WITH the reject-reason menu already open (dc.html 19725: rcCandOpen + rcRejMenu: true) so the enum reason is one click away.
findings.code_does: Menu reject only opens the card (RecruitingScreen.tsx:652); the user must find and click 불합격 again to reach the reason enum.
findings.fix: Pass an initialRejectMenuOpen flag into CandidateCard when entered via the menu path.

findings.design_says: §4-29 + change-log 183a: the gate CTA stays visible but fail-closed (dimmed, no-op) and a warn banner names exactly what remains ('남은 항목: …' — including the un-checked attest).
findings.code_does: PreflightModal hides the 게시 button entirely until publishable && attest (PreflightModal.tsx:79-81); when checks pass but attest is unchecked there is no banner and no CTA — the remaining step is undiscoverable.
findings.fix: Always render the CTA disabled and show the remaining-items warn banner covering both failed checks and the pending attest.

findings.design_says: §3: 'the next-action CTA is always exactly one' — the prototype's OFFER-stage card always exposes a single primary CTA (입사 확정 / 인력풀 등재, dc.html 19754).
findings.code_does: With an EXTENDED offer the card footer has no primary CTA at all — the next actions (수락 기록/거절 기록) are two ghost buttons inside the offer section (CandidateCard.tsx:279-282, 116-142 returns undefined).
findings.fix: Promote the reply-recording step to the footer primary (e.g. single '오퍼 회신 기록' CTA opening the accept/decline choice) so exactly one next action is always visible.

findings.design_says: §4.7-3: object links travel to the object in one click (링크 칩으로 상·하류 이동); hire creates a specific employee object.
findings.code_does: onOpenEmployee and onOpenPosition discard the id and navigate to module roots '/console/people' and '/console/objectExplorer' (RecruitingScreen.tsx:788-789), losing the drill target.
findings.fix: Deep-link with the object id (e.g. /console/people?employee={id}, explorer focus param) once those routes accept parameters.

findings.design_says: The provenance chip '원본 · {file}' is a button: clicking logs an audited view and surfaces the provenance path (dc.html 1548, 19740) — §4-13 file demoted to a secondary but live link.
findings.code_does: Rendered as a static span with a title tooltip (CandidateCard.tsx:217-221) — not clickable, no audited view.

findings.code_does: '등록된 공고가 없습니다' with no next action (RecruitingScreen.tsx:538, recruiting.ts:27); the manager's obvious next step (공고 등록) is only in the header.
